items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Cooper, Lou Leslie and Tim Gales come in to hear what he was talking about on the telephone.

ctx.x: was through then, and I'm through, I'm through. If I have to tell me wife I'm through, I'm through. You don't play games with a situation like that. If you're serious, be serious. But you can't just jump back and forth, back and forth. No good. And people will take advantage of you if you do it, like you need them.

And I got away from it. And the results of this, now, let me get into it. I played in the [White] Zanzibar in Philadelphia. Gale Agency called over. Lou Leslie was the guy -- about putting in a group in the [WHITE] Zanzibar. So Dick told them, said, "Man, we got the best attraction we could have in here. We don't need nobody now." He I said, "Who do you have?" He said, "We got Arnett Cobb from Lionel Hampton's band. He's packing them in." Say, "He is?" I'm just going to work for two weeks, and I'm going to rest…

Do you know that night they was there? Ralph Cooper, Lou Leslie and Tim Gales come in to hear what he was talking about on the telephone. And when he come in and heard the group, they asked him could -- on intermission -- could we take the group over to one of them halls on Broad Street because he had a band sound in there, and they permitted it. And we went over there.
